properties.state: {"description":"BUILT 2026-07-25 as `export_surface`. The first piece of req:design-composes, and deliberately the piece that EVERY answer to dec:nested-graphs needs: whatever composes, it composes through a published boundary rather than by reaching into another system's internals. Also the openness half of req:key-interfaces (\"a design that publishes a surface should be able to export exactly that surface\"). Contents: every Interface designated `published`, the artifacts that SPECIFIES or REALIZES it, the Components on each side, and the Project so a recipient knows whose surface they hold. Requirements, capabilities, decisions, verifications, history and every internal component stay home. Nodes are exported AS STORED — nothing trimmed or rewritten, because a fabricated node would import as a lie; what leaks internals is the graph BENEATH a component, and that is what is excluded. THE HONEST HALF, and the reason this is not just a filter: a recipient cannot tell a small design from a heavily filtered one, so the result counts and NAMES what it withheld, and says what the document is not (\"not a backup\"). A design with no designated boundary gets an EMPTY SURFACE warning rather than a quietly empty file — that case is dangerous precisely because it is indistinguishable from having nothing to share, and someone could publish it believing otherwise. It is NOT refused, because \"prove I publish nothing\" is a legitimate question. FOUND BY IMPACT-CHECK, before writing any code: propagate_change on cap:portability put dec:export-hash-chain in the direct ring, which is what stopped the surface from joining the file's hash chain. A derived view that advanced prev_content_hash would make compare_designs treat a published surface as an ancestor of the full design. FOUND BY A TEST: link_artifact writes REALIZES while the schema's intent for a contract artifact is SPECIFIES, so an ICD registered the ordinary way was missing from the surface. Both edges are honoured now — one is the contract as written, the other as built, and a recipient needs whichever exists. 7 tests, including the round trip: the other side imports it with zero skipped edges, gets the contract, and does not get our requirements.","is_entry_point":false,"is_exit_point":false,"name":"Publish just the boundary — the contracts others may rely on, and nothing internal","provenance":"authored","status":"verified","tier":"operational"}
